string.text: Replaces New Game Randomize with a D.O.G.M.A. button: Story on, Warfare/Azazel/Soulslike off, Veteran + Survivalist, Ironman with 2 lives (Invictus still possible), 500 RU, starter kit (ammo kit, 1911 at 50% parts, 2 medkits, 2 yadylin, rebreather), then starts the game. Faction, name, and spawn stay as you set them.
